== Nice map idea ==

Looks great.  Maybe try [http://tineye.com/ tineye] with the original image to locate source/copyright, but if you can't find it I wouldn't worry too much.

To caption images, include a "thumb" parameter.  I've done this on [[Arad Doman]]; see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Image_markup#New_syntax_for_images wikipedia's syntax page] for more details.

:Yeah, I agree, the uploads look really good and are useful for the purpose. I don't know much about copyright, so I'll just agree with Gherald on this. I think using a basic outline to illustrate something useful qualifies as fair use, and Tor seem to be fine with using images as long as we aren't slapping them on a mug. They have explicitly said that about the chapter icons and book covers. Incidentally, I introduced a friend to your blog and I think he is hooked. :P It's a quality blog, Adam. :) [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] 21:51, 14 May 2009 (UTC)
